title: The Pale Static
author: R. M. Sterling
blurb: Sable Galloway, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
